population: Canonical SEC ownership Table I P/S reported acquisitions/dispositions, with source-backed issuer/security/listing identity where available. P/S does not prove an open-market venue. Include unresolved, missing, terminal and non-actionable records in coverage accounting. No current ticker-universe filter.

feature_definitions.event_type: Canonical purchase/sale classification available under the declared source-public/actionable policy; not an assertion of open-market venue.
feature_definitions.reported_shares: Canonical transaction_shares quantity in shares, where supplied; no USD trade-size buckets because SEC reported-price currency is unknown.
feature_definitions.known_relationship_context: Positive count of source-backed matching relationship assertions with eligible known/valid intervals at the decision time. Unknown, late-known or absent/incomplete context is unavailable, never false or zero. No current LittleSis graph backfill.

expected_direction: Predeclared proposal: purchase-event 60-session SPY-relative mean exceeds sale-event mean. This is a descriptive contrast, not a short-sale strategy. 20/90-session comparisons are secondary and cannot replace a failed primary endpoint.
exclusions: All candidate events are accounted at each horizon. Exclude unsupported source/type and public-date windows explicitly; reject unknown/mismatched timing or identity. Do not drop unresolved, delisted, missing-price, censored or absent-current-universe records. Calendar year 2020 is an embargo between discovery and validation; no discovery event is selected in that year. Future window amendments require fresh review and cannot restore untouched status after inspection.
decision_standard: PROPOSED, NOT ACCEPTED: explicit analysis-plan sec-p-s/v2 supplies 1000 complete events and 200 distinct complete issuers per arm; >=90% complete 60-session coverage among selected actionable events separately for EACH arm; strict positive lower nearest-rank 95% issuer-cluster interval and strict positive purchase net excess at 25 bps. 5000 resamples, seed 1729, 10/25/50 bps round-trip stock costs; zero benchmark costs. Equal arm costs cancel in the contrast, not independent robustness tests. More than 1% missing-arm draws is insufficient. Primary 60 sessions only; 20/90 secondary cannot rescue it. Meeting these conditions is a conditional calculation, never investment validation or funding readiness. Amendment from v1 clarifies per-arm coverage before real analysis; no thresholds were chosen from returns.
dependence_and_inspection_policy: No IID inference across correlated event rows; report issuer event concentration. Before any real validation output, supervisor review must accept and register this exact protocol/code/origin inventory. Log all hypotheses, denied attempts and inspections in an append-only local journal. Prior overlapping real inspections, including under renamed hypotheses, prevent a new untouched claim; a crashed attempt is potentially inspected. This file is an unreviewed proposal, not a preregistration or claim that historical evidence is untouched. Separate supervisor approval of exact plan/code/origin/input-result scope and persistent reconciled inspection history is mandatory. Issuer-only inference does not settle common calendar dependence, overlap, multiplicity or availability/coverage sensitivity. Separate methodological acceptance remains required before any real positive investment claim; ephemeral production inactive under #15.
execution_and_costs: Hypothetical daily-bar open to Nth session close. Fixed round-trip stock cost sensitivities 10/25/50 bps; SPY benchmark cost zero. Sale events use long-stock outcomes, never short profits. These assumptions are not executions or a portfolio strategy.

availability_policies.rationale: Explicit SEC acceptance plus five-minute research assumption; not measured first dissemination or guaranteed vendor/collector latency.
